[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Special Array With X Elements Greater Than or Equal X** [LC 1608 · Special Array With X Elements Greater Than or Equal X](https://leetcode.com/problems/special-array-with-x-elements-greater-than-or-equal-x/){difficulty="Easy"}

$x$ equals a **count of elements**, so it lies in $[0, n]$ whatever the values are: the answer is a number in a small range, not a position in the array. Write $c(x)$ for the number of elements $\ge x$. Raising $x$ can only lower $c(x)$, while $x$ itself goes up, so $c(x) - x$ strictly decreases: the test "$c(x) \le x$" is false, …, false, true, …, true on $[0, n]$, and a special $x$ can only sit at its flip. Binary search $x$ for that flip, computing each $c(x)$ with one `bisect_left` on a sorted copy, then check whether $c(x) = x$ there.

[Solved in full in @sec-bst-p4-a.]{.card-link}
